WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM station_counts
), averages AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  observstation,
  telescope_count,
  share,
  share - average_share AS share_above_average
FROM averages
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY share_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
